description: Check an attestation a pre-trade check or send returned: that it was signed by the trader's keys (Ed25519 and, where present, post-quantum ML-DSA-65; both must hold) and not altered, and, given openings from the trader's commitments file, that committed account figures are what they claim. Offline; reads nothing from Alpaca.

attestation.description: An attestation object a check or send returned.

openings.description: Commitments to open: label, commitment, salt and value, from the trader's commitments.jsonl.

pq_public_key_pem.description: The signer's ML-DSA-65 public key (PEM), for an attestation also signed post-quantum; default this machine's CANLI_HOME/attest-ml-dsa-65.pub.pem.

public_key_pem.description: The signer's public key (PEM); default this machine's CANLI_HOME/attest-ed25519.pub.pem.
